### Verification Checklist (from 🧪 Hardware QA Tab)
- [ ] Number of keys verified: `X / 109 keys (Y%)`
- [ ] Modifiers working (Cmd -> Win, Option -> Alt, Ctrl, Shift)
- [ ] Italian/ISO AltGr characters working (no phantom Ctrl)
- [ ] Top row media keys working (Volume, Mute, Play/Pause)
- [ ] Missing system keys working (F13 -> PrintScreen, F14 -> ScrollLock, F15 -> Pause)
- [ ] Battery level reported accurately in tray and Settings
